content: robots.txt should reference the sitemap location (Sitemap: https://.../sitemap.xml) and never disallow a URL that's also listed in the sitemap. Sitemap entries must be canonical, indexable, 200-status, and under 50k URLs/50MB (a 400-game catalog is trivially under this). For Phoenix specifically: serve sitemap.xml either as a static generated file (mix task regenerating on deploy/seed-change) or a dynamic controller action rendering XML from Ecto data directly - the Elixir 'sitemap' hex package exists to help build indexes/pings but a hand-rolled controller is simple enough at this scale (400 rows).
